ideas.children_he: גַּם כְּשֶׁמְּחַכִּים הַרְבֵּה זְמַן, יְכוֹלָה לְהַגִּיעַ שִׂמְחָה גְּדוֹלָה.
ideas.children_en: Abraham and Sarah had a son named Isaac when they were old, just as God promised. Isaac was circumcised and born at the right time. Sarah was happy and laughed about this miracle.

ideas.children_he: קִנְאָה בֵּין אַחִים עֲלוּלָה לִפְגֹּעַ בַּמִּשְׁפָּחָה.
ideas.children_en: Isaac grew up and Abraham celebrated. Sarah saw Isaac and Ishmael couldn't live together because of Ishmael's behavior and asked Abraham to send them away.

ideas.children_he: פְּרֵדָה מֵהַבַּיִת עֲלוּלָה לִהְיוֹת מַפְחִידָה וְקָשָׁה.
ideas.children_en: Abraham sent Hagar and Ishmael with some food and water into the desert, and they went to a far place whose exact location is unclear.

ideas.children_he: גַּם כְּשֶׁמַּרְגִּישִׁים לְבַד, אֶפְשָׁר לִמְצֹא תִּקְוָה.
ideas.children_en: God heard Ishmael's cry and told Hagar not to fear because Ishmael will survive and become a leader of a great nation.

ideas.children_he: מַיִם וְעֶזְרָה בִּזְמַן מַצּוּקָה יְכוֹלִים לְהַצִּיל חַיִּים.
ideas.children_en: God showed Hagar a well, Ishmael got better. He grew up in the desert and became a skilled hunter. His mother found him a wife from Egypt.

ideas.children_he: הֶסְכֵּם שָׁלוֹם עוֹזֵר לִשְׁכֵנִים לִחְיוֹת בְּיַחַד.
ideas.children_en: Abimelech and Phicol came to Abraham and said that God helped him. They made a promise to be loyal and keep good relations.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ מַחֲלֹקֶת, כְּדַאי לְדַבֵּר וּלְבָרֵר מָה קָרָה.
ideas.children_en: Abraham reminded that his servants were stealing water he dug. Abimelech said he didn’t know and admitted the well belonged to Abraham.

ideas.children_he: הַבְטָחוֹת חֲשׁוּבוֹת צְרִיכוֹת לִהְיוֹת בְּרוּרוֹת לִשְׁנֵי הַצְּדָדִים.
ideas.children_en: Abraham gave sheep and cattle to Abimelech and they made a pact. Seven sheep were proof that the well belonged to Abraham.

ideas.children_he: שֵׁם שֶׁל מָקוֹם יָכוֹל לְהַזְכִּיר סִפּוּר מִן הֶעָבָר.
ideas.children_en: The place was called Be'er Sheva because Abraham and Abimelech swore there. That is why it got its name.

ideas.children_he: אַחֲרֵי שֶׁעוֹשִׂים שָׁלוֹם, כָּל אֶחָד יָכוֹל לַחֲזֹר לְבֵיתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: After the oath at Be’er Sheva, Abimelech and Phicol went back to Philistia, where they came from before visiting Abraham.
Abraham planted a tree at Be’er Sheva and named it the LORD God of eternity, continuing his habit to teach about God wherever he lived.

ideas.children_he: גַּם בְּמָקוֹם זָר אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת חַיִּים.
ideas.children_en: Abraham did not return to Hebron at once but lived as a foreigner in Philistia for a long time.
